class spark_batch_trainer.CatBoostTrainer[source]

Bases: BatchTrainer

Batch trainer for CatBoost classifiers.

This class supports incremental training in mini-batches on Spark DataFrames, with validation support, global early stopping, and categorical feature handling.

Initialize the CatBoost batch trainer.

_global_train_loss

Training loss history across all batches.

Type:

list of list of float

_global_valid_loss

Validation loss history across all batches.

Type:

list of list of float

_global_iterations

Indices of processed batches.

Type:

list of int

_model

Final trained CatBoost model after training.

Type:

CatBoostClassifier or None

_categorical_features

Names of categorical features if any were detected.

Type:

list of str or None

_optimizer

Utility for reducing memory usage of validation DataFrames (optimizes size in MB before training).

Type:

MemoryOptimizer

_weight_calculator

Utility for computing and caching sample/class weights across training batches.

Type:

OptimizedWeightCalculator

fit(train_dataframe, valid_dataframe, target_column, **kwargs)[source]

Train a CatBoost classifier incrementally on Spark DataFrames in batches.

Parameters:

  • train_dataframe (SparkDataFrame or None) – Training dataset in Spark DataFrame format.

  • valid_dataframe (SparkDataFrame or None) – Validation dataset in Spark DataFrame format. Required for metric tracking and early stopping.

  • target_column (str) – Target column name in both train and validation DataFrames.

  • **kwargs (dict) –

    Additional configuration dictionaries.

    • config_modeldict

      CatBoost hyperparameters.

    • config_trainingdict

      Training options such as num_batches (int), eval_metric (str), use_sample_weight (bool), max_patience (int).

Returns:

The trained model is stored internally in self.model.

Return type:

None

Raises:

  • ValueError – If input DataFrames or target column are invalid.

  • RuntimeError – If no model is successfully trained.

Notes

  • Supports global early stopping across batches.

  • Handles categorical features automatically if detected.

get_trained_model()[source]

Retrieve the final trained model instance.

Returns:

Trained model object (e.g. CatBoostClassifier).

Return type:

Any

class spark_batch_trainer.LightGBMTrainer[source]

Bases: BatchTrainer

Batch trainer for LightGBM classifiers.

This class supports incremental training in mini-batches on Spark DataFrames, with validation support, early stopping, sample weighting, and learning rate scheduling.

Initialize the LightGBM batch trainer.

_global_train_loss

History of training loss values for each batch.

Type:

list of list of float

_global_valid_loss

History of validation loss values for each batch.

Type:

list of list of float

_global_iterations

Indices of processed batches during training.

Type:

list of int

_model

The trained LightGBM model instance (set after training).

Type:

LGBMClassifier or None

_lr_schedulers

History of learning rates applied per batch.

Type:

list of float

_categorical_features

Names of categorical features used for training.

Type:

list of str or None

_weight_calculator

Utility to compute optimized sample weights per batch.

Type:

OptimizedWeightCalculator

_optimizer

Utility for reducing memory usage of validation DataFrames (optimizes size in MB before training).

Type:

MemoryOptimizer

fit(train_dataframe, valid_dataframe, target_column, **kwargs)[source]

Train a LightGBM classifier incrementally on Spark DataFrames in batches.

Parameters:

  • train_dataframe (SparkDataFrame or None) – Training dataset in Spark DataFrame format.

  • valid_dataframe (SparkDataFrame or None) – Validation dataset in Spark DataFrame format. Required for metric tracking and early stopping.

  • target_column (str) – Target column name in both train and validation DataFrames.

  • **kwargs (dict) –

    Additional configuration dictionaries.

    • config_modeldict

      LightGBM hyperparameters. learning_rate may be updated batch-wise.

    • config_trainingdict

      Training options such as num_batches (int), eval_metric (str), use_sample_weight (bool).

    • config_lr_schedulerdict or callable or None

      Learning rate scheduler configuration.

Returns:

The trained model is stored internally in self._model.

Return type:

None

Raises:

  • ValueError – If input DataFrames or target column are invalid.

  • RuntimeError – If no model is successfully trained.

Notes

  • Supports early stopping based on validation loss.

  • Learning rate can be scheduled across batches.

fit(train_dataframe, valid_dataframe, target_column, **kwargs)[source]

Train an XGBoost classifier incrementally on Spark DataFrames in batches.

Parameters:

  • train_dataframe (SparkDataFrame or None) – Training dataset in Spark DataFrame format.

  • valid_dataframe (SparkDataFrame or None) – Validation dataset in Spark DataFrame format. Required for metric tracking and early stopping.

  • target_column (str) – Target column name in both train and validation DataFrames.

  • **kwargs (dict) –

    Additional configuration dictionaries.

    • config_modeldict

      XGBoost hyperparameters. learning_rate may be updated batch-wise.

    • config_trainingdict

      Training options such as num_batches (int), eval_metric (str), use_sample_weight (bool), max_patience (int).

    • config_lr_schedulerdict or None

      Learning rate scheduler configuration.

Returns:

The trained model is stored internally in self._model.

Return type:

None

Raises:

  • ValueError – If input DataFrames or target column are invalid.

  • RuntimeError – If no model is successfully trained.

Notes

  • Supports early stopping based on validation loss.

  • Supports warm-restart training across batches.

  • Learning rate can be scheduled dynamically per batch.
